item.title: Gamer92000 / echo-dot-assist
item.description: Turn Amazon Echos (Echo Dot 3, Echo Dot 2, Echo 2) into local Home Assistant voice satellites. Keeps Amazon's mic processing and wake word engine, replaces Alexa with a small C daemon speaking ESPHome or Wyoming. Multiroom music via Music Assistant, Bluetooth speaker and proxy, no cloud.
